tech_evidence.share: ~55% (44 of 80 sampled styles name Lift Tuck; 628 of 1,298 listings tagged Lift Tuck)

craft_evidence.mills: yes, one line — Re-New denim 'created with ISKO Reform technology and recycled denim from RE&UP'
craft_evidence.madein: ~1% (1 of 80 sampled pages states a country)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated — founded 2003; no place of making
craft_evidence.process: construction only (Lift Tuck panel and contoured seams), not making
craft_evidence.reasoning: One mill (ISKO, plus RE&UP for recycled fibre) is named for one denim line; no factory, maker or country is stated across the range. A named mill on a single line with nothing else is a 2.
